summary: Defines BackendSpec, a frozen kw-only subclass of mountainash_settings.profiles.ProfileSpec that adds database metadata: default_port, connection_string_scheme, ibis_dialect, rides_on, a required non-empty supported_auth tuple, and resource-read fields. __post_init__ rejects an empty supported_auth and derives a default resource-read disposition, locator prefixes and projection phase (settings URL, connected identity for pyspark, override-only for databricks and URL-less backends). Also defines the DatabaseResourceReadDisposition and LocatorProjectionPhase enums and re-exports MISSING, Missing and ParameterSpec.
extension_points: Each backend declares one BackendSpec instance (name, provider_type, ibis_dialect, supported_auth, parameters) as its __spec__.
lifecycle_notes: Frozen dataclass: derived resource-read defaults are written with object.__setattr__ in __post_init__.
Resource-read override dates are hard-coded to 2026-08-29.
BackendDescriptor and _Missing remain as deprecated module attributes.
documentation_hooks: Anatomy of a BackendSpec: identity, Ibis routing (ibis_dialect, rides_on), auth matrix, parameter list
Credential-safe resource-read dispositions and when each applies
risks: Resource-read disposition is special-cased by backend name (pyspark, databricks) inside the generic spec class rather than declared on those specs.
CLAUDE.md still calls this class BackendDescriptor subclassing ProfileDescriptor.
open_questions: Which consumer reads the resource_read_* fields? No reader exists in this package's src; it appears to serve a downstream credential-safe read path.
